page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a printed ornament (woodcut device) below the text; faint marginal fragments at the right edge are show-through or cut-off text and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: quantur. Hæc una pietas juveniles cupiditates refrænat, ne extra metas rectæ rationis erumpant, petulantiam comprimit, insolentiam frangit, temeritatem coërcet, hominesque modestos reddit & legibus atque legum custodibus obsequentes. Quod faxit clementissimus Pater Domini N. J. C H. in Spiritu S. unus ille verus Deus laudandus in omnem æternitatem, Amen.
main_text.head: PANE.

page.notes: The ornament below the text is a woodcut device and is not transcribed. Right-margin fragments are cut-off text from the adjacent column and are left out. Small marks at the right edge of the first lines (cupiditate, insolentiam, Pater) may be cut-off line ends; the words are read as printed where legible.
